verdict.rationale: Postman is an API platform, and the evidence even mentions a Fabric gateway for registering MCP servers, so traffic rate limiting is a fair question here. However, no evidence documents enforcing rate limits per consumer or per route. The closest item, simulating performance constraints against local mock servers, is a testing feature, not traffic enforcement.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce rate limits on API traffic per consumer or route
